analysis_A_chen_sampling_rate.reference_rate_note: 100 Hz is the highest rate cached for both pupil and gaze (gaze exists only as 100 Hz epochs; raw 1 kHz pupil is cached but not gaze). 60 and 30 Hz are anti-aliased polyphase decimations of the 100 Hz epochs.

rules.ek: max(30, 6 x sqrt((SDx^2+SDy^2)/2)), SD = sqrt(median(v^2)-median(v)^2) per axis (Engbert & Kliegl 2003 style)
